Sometimes, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 0f 00}
you find yourself a little
strapped for cash.
It's no big deal. I mean,
it happens to everyone
sometimes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Well let me tell you, if you
need some pocket change
fast, here's a little tip.
{07 14 00}Collect shells on the beach!
You can sell them for some
quick money, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 14 00}I like to take a nice
walk on the beach in the
morning, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Some mornings, it's so nice
and peaceful that you can
hear just about anything.
{07 0d 00}Sometimes, I think I hear
the sound of the Earth
revolving, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 14 00}This is just about the best
time to take a walk out
on the beach, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 0d 00}After an especially busy
morning,{01 00 00 05 00} it's nice to spend
your day out on the beach.

I've been spending a lot of
time at the beach lately,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}It's nice to be out by
yourself at night on the
beach, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 00 00}Nobody comes around to
bother you,{01 00 00 05 00} and you can sit
alone with your thoughts.

{07 16 00}The ocean is so dark this
late at night. I feel like it
might swallow me whole!
{07 13 00}It's almost too beautiful.
It's almost a little bit
frightening, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 03 00}Wrong-o!{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Sorry, but {ff 00 00 07}coral{ff 00 00 00}
is the wrong answer!

Looks like you've still got
a lot to learn about the
sea, {04 1f 00}!

{07 0a 00}Ding ding ding! We have a
winner, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 16 00}And you know what? {ff 00 00 07}White
scallops{ff 00 00 00} are just about the
hardest shells to find!
{07 06 00}I've been trying to get
enough to make a necklace
for ages now, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 06 00}Oooo, {01 00 00 0a 00}sorry!{01 00 00 0f 00} You were
close, but {ff 00 00 07}{07 16 00}conch {ff 00 00 00}is the
wrong answer, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 14 00}To tell you the truth, I
wish they were worth more.
{ff 00 00 07}Conchs {ff 00 00 00}are my favorites.
{07 13 00}When you hold them up to
your ear,{01 00 00 0f 00}{07 09 00} you can hear the
wind echoing in your head.
